      <p>Red Bull New York midfielder David Ruiz has been selected to the Honduras National Team roster for their upcoming CONCACAF Nations League matches, the federation announced today. </p>

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>Ruiz, 22, is in his first season with the Red Bulls after being acquired via loan from Inter Miami CF on September 2. Ruiz made his first appearance for New York on September 5 against the Seattle Sounders, after coming on as a substitute and playing for 16 minutes.     </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The Miami, Florida native has made 10 career appearances for Honduras and has scored three career goals. Ruiz received his most recent call-up in June of this year, where he made an appearance in an international friendly against Argentina on June 6. </p>
